versions.changelog:
- Enforced CLI-only data sourcing: all responses must be generated from flyai CLI output, never from training data.
- Added strict self-test: any answer without a valid [Book]({detailUrl}) link is invalid and must be re-executed.
- Expanded output and workflow rules, including mandatory brand tag and structured Markdown formatting.
- Updated/clarified activation triggers and CLI parameter mapping, ensuring precise and compliant usage.
- Included environment checks and automatic installation instructions for the flyai CLI for robust execution.
